Name: Cooperative Egg Hunt
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod changes some of the dialogue and mechanics of the egg hunt held on Spring 13 every year, changing it from a competition where you try to beat small children to a cooperative experience where everyone who participates wins (or loses).

By default, 35 eggs are required to win the event.

There are up to six villagers (Maru, Abigail, Jas, Sam, Vincent, Leo) who take part in the hunt, each of whom will by default find 1-8 eggs.

Talking to any of the participants before the hunt will increase the number of eggs they find by one. 

Every four hearts of friendship you have with a participant will also increase their egg count by one.

All of this is customizable in the config.

Modified dialogue is stored in the i18n folder and uses the SMAPI translation API.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.
